title: Equal-weight energy book: carry, basis-momentum, value and trend, March 2014 to April 2024
question: On rolled NYMEX crude oil, heating oil, gasoline and natural gas futures from 2014-03-03 to 2024-04-05, after the basis-momentum paper's sample, does the equal-weight average of carry, basis-momentum, 5-year value and 12-month trend scores have a positive Sharpe ratio that passes at least four of the five reality tests, after 3 bp per unit traded and 2 bp per roll?
prior_trials_note: 313 (REG-0008's floor) + 2 (REG-0008's own strategies), counted across all families as the project has so far. energy_tsmom and energy_carry, two of the four ingredients, are already counted through REG-0007. Basis-momentum and value were never evaluated alone, so per RES-0016 rule 4 they add no trials beyond this book, which counts as one. This is a floor: it does not include the always-on search's variations (engine/output/search.db on the owner's machine), which have never included energy futures because fut.* is not on main yet.
what_would_change_our_mind: A pass would make the energy book the project's first combined strategy with a real effect after publication, worth a forward test once a source of futures prices after April 2024 is found. A fail with ingredients that pass on their own (REG-0007) would say that equal-weight combining does not help with only four contracts.
already_seen: No. Before registering, only unit tests on made-up prices were run (each ingredient's direction, equal weights, no look-ahead, mutation checks). No return, Sharpe ratio or other performance number was computed for energy_book, for basis-momentum or for value on these contracts. Two ingredients, energy_tsmom and energy_carry, are registered in REG-0007 and have not been run either.
